hubTrigger.claim: China's trade engine and surplus remain strong despite tariff pressure.
China's share of global container exports reached about 40%, up roughly 2.5 percentage points in nine months.
China is gaining share in higher-value machinery and transport-equipment exports, pressuring European manufacturers.

causalNeighborhood: If China's advantage is increasingly an integrated manufacturing ecosystem rather than only low labor cost, equipment makers with proven overseas channels, localized service and rising export margins are candidate expressions.

candidates.name: 三一重工

Overseas gross margin rose to 32.50%, +1.32pp; growth was broad across Asia/Australia, Europe, Americas and Africa.
risk: hub event is continuation/magnitude update rather than a company-specific order shock

mappingConclusion: Sany, XCMG and Liugong all show realized export conversion. This is a continuation/magnitude signal from broad hubs, so selection requires low/moderate absorption or a fresh company delta; otherwise the cluster remains context rather than a new trade.
